Home / Management proposal

How a management proposal is put together.

We do not publish package prices, because two flats in the same building can need very different attention. What we do publish is exactly what the fee depends on and what the proposal will spell out.

What shapes the fee

Property type

An apartment with an association behind it needs different work from a standalone villa with a garden, tank and compound wall.

Location

Travel time to the property affects how often it can be visited economically. See the areas we cover.

Occupancy and tenant status

Vacant, tenant-occupied and owner-occupied properties call for different visit patterns and different coordination.

Inspection frequency

Monthly, quarterly, or around specific events such as the monsoon and tenant changes.

Maintenance coordination

A newly built flat and a fifteen-year-old house generate very different volumes of repair work to coordinate.

Reporting requirements

Some owners want a photo update after each visit; others want a quarterly summary for their accountant as well.

Additional services

Tenant sourcing, readiness for a family visit, refurbishment coordination and similar work are scoped and quoted separately.

Number of properties

Several properties in the same area can be covered more efficiently, and the proposal reflects that.

What the proposal states

  • Scope: every included service, with the inspection frequency
  • The management fee and how it is calculated
  • Billing schedule and GST
  • Any minimum fee, if applicable
  • Approval limits and the emergency procedure
  • What is excluded, and that vendor charges are separate and paid by the owner
  • Reporting: what, how often, on which channel
  • Notice period for ending the arrangement

What you will not find in it

Guarantees of rent, promises of zero risk, or "no hidden charges" slogans. Vendor costs are by nature not known in advance; the proposal explains how they are quoted and approved instead of pretending they do not exist.

Request a tailored proposal

Tell us about the property and we will send a written proposal after a short call. No obligation, no fee for the consultation.
